---
id: env.end.e03
type: endorsement
heading: E03 Non-owned Disposal Sites
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
trigger:
  questions:
  - qs.env.ops.arranges_waste_disposal
  rules:
  - when: qs.env.ops.arranges_waste_disposal == true
    action: suggest
  reason: Suggested because you choose or arrange the sites where waste from your work is disposed of.
---

[[ref:env.excl.non-owned-disposal-sites]] does not apply to a pollution condition at a disposal site in Australia that held every licence required by environmental law at the time your waste was sent to it, and that is not owned or operated by you. The most we will pay under this endorsement is the sub-limit shown in the schedule for it, which is part of and not in addition to the limit of liability.

Schedule variables: the sub-limit; any named sites excluded.
